'''2004 Illinois State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Illinois (2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. The Players Committee's errata of June 2006 credit the original concept of Combat Readiness (V) and Careful Planning (V) to "Kevin Brownell, Illinois States 2004".<ref name="pc-sid11">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220104/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=11 Current Errata - June 12/13, 2006 - PDF Update], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 June 2006.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Illinois
* '''Dates:''' 2004
